'''2002 World Championship''' was the first Players Committee Star Wars CCG World Championship, run at [[DecipherCon 2002]] (Chesapeake Conference Center, 31 October–3 November 2002).<ref name="dcon-fmt">[https://web.archive.org/web/20020810223927/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/worldsformats.html World Championship Event Formats & Prizes] (Wayback, 10 August 2002)</ref><ref name="tfn">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/World_Championship_Results_announced_64778.asp World Championship Results announced], theforce.net (3 November 2002)</ref><ref name="pc-sw">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021221153832/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1103swyjjkresults.html Star Wars Players Committee 2002 World Championships], Kathy McCracken, Decipher Daily News (3 November 2002)</ref>

[[File:DecipherCon 2002 tournament hall.jpg|thumb|right|320px|Main tournament hall, 31 October 2002]]
[[File:DecipherCon 2002 Star Wars World Champion trophy.jpg|thumb|right|320px|Star Wars CCG World Champion trophy]]

[[Angelo Consoli]] won. [[Greg Shaw]] finished 2nd. 3rd and 4th were [[Brian Terwilliger]] and [[Brian Fred]]. 5th–8th: [[Hayes Hunter]], [[Jonny Chu|Johnny Chu]], [[Brian Rippetoe]], [[Bastian Winkelhaus]].<ref name="tfn" /><ref name="pc-sw" /> A 2020 forum compilation lists [[Clint Hays]] in place of Hayes Hunter among 5th–8th; a reply in the same thread corrects it to Hayes Hunter, as in the official results.<ref name="f75427-1300387">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300387#p1300387 Post by Yoshi], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211006195438/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=75427 Internet Archive], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="f75427-1300392">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=1300392#p1300392 Post by Death Star], "SWCCG Worlds Day 3 Standings History", forum.starwarsccg.org (28 May 2020). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20211006195438/https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=75427 Internet Archive], [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012152200/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t75427.html Internet Archive]</ref>

The constructed pool was [[Premiere - Original VS3]]: printed sets through [[Theed Palace]] plus original virtual cards through [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution|VS3]] (legal 20 September 2002). Shaw posted a Light [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|There Is Good In Him]] list on DeckTech (DCon2k2 Runner Up - LS). [[Angelo Consoli]] posted the Dark [[2002 World Championship Angelo Consoli DS|No Money, No Parts, No Deal!]] Watto 60 that won. [[Keith Watabayashi]] posted the Day 2 Light TIGIH also played by [[Brad Reinhold]]. [[Kyle Krueger]] posted a Day 1 Light Jedi Council Chamber list (''It's a Kyle deck'').

Two Day 1 heats ran Thursday 31 October and Friday 1 November at 2:00 PM: six games of Swiss, top 20% to Day 2. Day 2 on Saturday 2 November started at 10:00 AM. The top 8 played single elimination from 6:00 PM. The final ended at 5:30 AM on Sunday 3 November. [[Jim Colson]] announced the places at the Sunday awards.<ref name="swsched">[https://web.archive.org/web/20021023190505/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/events/eventschedule-otherccg.html Event schedule: Star Wars, Young Jedi, Jedi Knights], Decipher (Wayback 23 October 2002)</ref><ref name="tfn-sched">[https://www.theforce.net/ccg/story/Star_Wars_CCG_Explodes_at_DecipherCon_2002_65230.asp Star Wars CCG Explodes at DecipherCon 2002], theforce.net (20 September 2002)</ref><ref name="d4">[https://web.archive.org/web/20030220124438/http://www.decipher.com/deciphercon/2002/reports/1103dayfourwrapup.html Until Next Time: Day Four Wrapup], Marcus Sheppard, Decipher Daily News (3 November 2002)</ref><ref name="pc-sw" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Dates:''' 31 October–3 November 2002
* '''Site:''' [[DecipherCon 2002]], Chesapeake Conference Center
* '''Purse:''' $10,000
